Better Lovers — Lie Between the Lines

Clean Intro  ·  Drop D  ·  ♩ = 99  ·  Section A

Guitar Routine — Clean Intro (~45 min)

Warm-Up (5 min)

Slow chromatic runs across all 6 strings. Even pick attack, no rushing.

Step 1 — Isolate the Skip (5 min)

Play only the two notes across each skip: open low D → target B or e string fret. No G string noise allowed.

  • No metronome first — just clean contact
  • Once clean: add click at 50 BPM, 8th notes

Step 2 — Two-Bar Chunks (15 min)

Break the intro into 2-bar segments. Each segment:

  1. 60 BPM — clean 4x in a row before moving up
  2. 75 BPM — same standard
  3. 99 BPM — target tempo

Don't chain segments until each is solid individually.

Step 3 — Picking Arc Drill (5 min)

Rest pinky lightly on the body as a reference anchor. Play D → skip → target string slowly. The arc should feel identical every rep. If you hear the G string: wrist is staying too flat — lift it slightly after the D string hit.

Step 4 — Full Intro Run (10 min)

Measures 1–16 at 99 BPM straight through. Note any bar that breaks. Return to Step 2 for just that bar, then re-run the full intro.

Step 5 — Push Into Section B (5 min)

If Section A is solid: look at the main riff (♩=135, page 2 of this viewer). Distortion, palm mute on open D. Don't aim for clean — just feel how it follows the intro.

Cool-Down (5 min)

Free noodling in Drop D. No structure. Let the hands relax.
